title: MNP-XH04 NEZHA
summary: Everything is as good as you could expect from a Motor Nuclear model kit: quality plastic, highly detailed armors, a lot of pointy pieces, and gems. The 6 hand gimmick is fresh and fun to play with, especially when we have varieties of hands to compose.
body: Everything is as good as you could expect from a Motor Nuclear model kit: quality plastic, highly detailed armors, a lot of pointy pieces, and gems. The 6 hand gimmick is fresh and fun to play with, especially when we have varieties of hands to compose.

However, I found it is more difficult to assemble the leg and hand joints into body this time. It is too tight and requires a lot of force to put them together. Once it is done, they stick together pretty well but the part before that is quite a challenge. Also pointy armor means you have to be careful playing around and applying pressure.
Also, assembling the equipment can be such a chore. Too many small pieces putting together repeatedly.
As usual, the final product is still a masterpiece to look at. No regret. But I would not build this kit a second time. At least not for a while.
